name: Stick Shoulder Internal Rotation

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: AAOS Shoulder Active-Assisted Range of Motion Protocol

steps: Stand tall holding a light stick, dowel, or cane horizontally behind your back with both hands.
Grip the stick with an overhand grip, keeping your elbows comfortably relaxed.
Using your unaffected arm, gently push or slide the stick across your lower back toward the affected side.
This guides your target arm into internal rotation and adduction across your lower back.
Hold the comfortable stretch for 3 to 5 seconds at the end-range of motion.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.
coaching_cues: Keep your chest lifted and shoulders from hunching forward excessively.
The unaffected arm supplies the gentle driving force; the target shoulder should stay relaxed.
Never force through sharp, pinch-like pain.

sources.attribution: AAOS Shoulder Conditioning & Active-Assisted Range of Motion Protocol
